name: Bloom of the Heavens

angles.text: As a night elf, you can treasure Nord'el as a botanical relic of Mount Hyjal, gathered before your people moved their home to Teldrassil.
For the Alliance, the Flying Osprey sailed alongside the Kul Tiran Third Fleet before both met disaster off Menethil Harbor.
As a herbalist, you know Nord'el as a rare night elf flower gathered beneath the full moon atop Mount Hyjal, a remarkable botanical specimen.

aliases: what is bloom of the heavens
faq.answer: In Darnassian, Nord'el means Bloom of the Heavens. Night elves gather this sacred flower after it blossoms beneath a full moon atop Mount Hyjal, their ancestral mountain home.
The Flying Osprey was a night elf vessel sailing with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Many moons ago, it wrecked on the Wetlands coast just south of Menethil Harbor, scattering its cargo.
Sylessa Duskwhisper is a night elf emissary who sailed from Auberdine and Teldrassil to Menethil Harbor to recover the lost bloom for her people.

aliases: why are murlocs at the wreck
faq.answer: Fierce murloc raiders occupy the coastal wreck south of Menethil Harbor. They claim the remains of the Flying Osprey, making salvage dangerous for Sylessa.
Night elves gathered Nord'el atop Mount Hyjal, their former home, before they founded Teldrassil. Its sacred harvest beneath the full moon gives the flower deep cultural and emotional value.
faq.q: Why is Nord'el so important to the night elves?

faq.answer: The Flying Osprey lies on the rocky coast just south of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. Hostile murlocs occupy the wreck.
faq.q: Where can the wreckage be found?

sections.body: Sylessa Duskwhisper has come from Auberdine to Menethil Harbor to recover Nord'el. The flower was gathered beneath a full moon atop Mount Hyjal, and holds deep meaning for the night elves. Those who now live in Teldrassil treasure relics from their ancestral mountain as reminders of their heritage.
sections.title: A Relic of Mount Hyjal

sections.body: Many moons ago, the night elf vessel Flying Osprey wrecked on the rocky coast south of Menethil Harbor while sailing with the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Its ruined hull rests in the shallows. Fierce murloc raiders have made the wreck their home and defend it from anyone seeking the night elf cargo.
sections.title: The Fate of the Flying Osprey

summary: Sylessa Duskwhisper searches the waters south of Menethil Harbor for Bloom of the Heavens. The sacred flower Nord'el was lost when the night elf vessel Flying Osprey wrecked alongside ships of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet. Murlocs now occupy the wreck, where Nord'el lies among the ruins.
attribution: In-game quest text: Bloom of the Heavens
